summary: Local stack up: compose (Postgres + LiteLLM), OpenAI key from Windows Credential Manager
epic_summary: WS-B Agent runtime (Deep Agents, Docker sandbox backend, subagents, skills, stuck detection)
description:
## Do

* `scripts/up.ps1`: read the OpenAI key from Windows Credential Manager (where the owner stored it) into the process environment only, then `docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d`. The key never lands in a file.
* Verify the gateway answers on aliases `anvil-main`, `anvil-fast`, `anvil-embed` and logs spend.

## Acceptance

* A curl to `localhost:4000/v1/chat/completions` with model `anvil-fast` returns; spend visible in LiteLLM.

comments.body: [claude] PR https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/1 open, waiting for codex review. Stack is running on this laptop: anvil-postgres (5433, healthy), anvil-gateway (4000, healthy). Verified: anvil-fast and anvil-main answer, anvil-embed returns 1536-dim vectors, spend logged per request. Not re-verified: a cold `scripts/up.ps1` run after raising the healthcheck retries.
